description:
Maintainer (2026-10-13): mix ci compiles only 6 example scripts' kernels (Defk.Catalog) plus fuzzy_search's kernels.ex; ~25 examples are never compiled in CI, so a compiler change can break e.g. lz4 or keccak with CI green. Only examples/run_all.exs (manual, benchmarks) runs them.

Goal: (1) mix test runs a selected few examples that test the compiler output: fast ones, covering different compiler areas; no example whose expected verdict is poor/out_of_scope. (2) Running all other examples moves to its own task, outside mix ci. (3) Decide what to do with fuzzy_search, a whole app.
title: Examples in CI: a fast compiler-coverage subset in mix test, everything else in its own task
